questions.subject: Programming skills · Events
questions.text: A map should zoom when the plus button is clicked. Which event should trigger zooming?
answers: A click on the plus button
questions.explanation: The handler should respond to the specified user action.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Events
questions.text: Pressing R should reset a timer. Where should the reset action be placed?
answers: Only in an unrelated click handler
questions.explanation: The matching key event should execute the reset action.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Events
questions.text: A button click runs two handlers, and both add 1 to a counter. How much is added per click?
questions.explanation: Each handler contributes one increment when that click triggers both.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Events
questions.text: Why test a button with both mouse and keyboard activation when both are supported?
answers: To ensure every event fires twice
To verify both input routes perform the intended action
questions.explanation: Different supported inputs should produce the intended equivalent response.
